headline: First contested presidential election in 35 years set for Bangladesh
summary: An 11-party alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami has nominated Colonel (Retd) Oli Ahmed to challenge the BNP's dominant majority in the upcoming vote.
details: For the first time in 35 years, Bangladesh will see a contested presidential election. While the BNP holds a two-thirds majority in the current parliament, making their candidate's victory nearly certain, an 11-party alliance has decided to field a challenger.

The alliance, led by Jamaat-e-Islami and including the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), National Citizen Party (NCP), and others, has nominated Colonel (Retd) Oli Ahmed, the chairman of the LDP, for the presidency.

Colonel Oli Ahmed is a decorated freedom fighter (Bir Bikram) and a former close associate of Ziaur Rahman. He previously served as the Communications Minister in the first government of Begum Khaleda Zia.
Analysts suggest Jamaat-e-Islami's decision to nominate a freedom fighter is a strategic move to counter long-standing criticisms regarding the party's role during the 1971 Liberation War.
The 11-party alliance's move is also seen as an effort to demonstrate their active participation in the parliamentary democratic process, despite the numerical disadvantage in the current parliament.
The BNP currently holds a significant majority compared to the 78 members of the 11-party alliance, making the contest a symbolic but politically significant battle of narratives.
caption:

Analysts suggest Jamaat-e-Islami's decision to nominate a freedom fighter is a strategic move to counter long-standing criticisms regarding the party's role during the 1971 Liberation War.

The 11-party alliance's move is also seen as an effort to demonstrate their active participation in the parliamentary democratic process, despite the numerical disadvantage in the current parliament.

headline: Actor Don arrested in Salman Shah murder case while heading to Saudi Arabia
summary: The CID has arrested the 4th accused in a 29-year-old cold case involving the death of the legendary actor Salman Shah.
details: The CID has arrested actor Don, the fourth accused in the Salman Shah murder case, at the airport as he was preparing to leave for Saudi Arabia.
Salman Shah died under mysterious circumstances on September 6, 1996. A murder case was filed in October 2021 based on a complaint by his mother, Neela Chowdhury.
The case involves 11 accused individuals, including Salman's wife, Samira Khanum.
According to state prosecutors, Don had a relationship with Samira and was allegedly involved in a contract killing of Salman Shah for 12 lakh BDT.
Following the arrest, Don was produced before a court and has been sent to jail.
caption:
Arrested at the airport while fleeing to Saudi Arabia—actor Don is now in custody for the 1996 murder of Salman Shah.

The CID has arrested actor Don, the fourth accused in the Salman Shah murder case, at the airport as he was preparing to leave for Saudi Arabia.

Salman Shah died under mysterious circumstances on September 6, 1996. A murder case was filed in October 2021 based on a complaint by his mother, Neela Chowdhury.

The case involves 11 accused individuals, including Salman's wife, Samira Khanum.

According to state prosecutors, Don had a relationship with Samira and was allegedly involved in a contract killing of Salman Shah for 12 lakh BDT.

Following the arrest, Don was produced before a court and has been sent to jail.
